title: SecurityEventPayload
description: Payload schema for the SECURITY_EVENT intent. Aligned with the existing SecurityEventSystem schema in security_events.json. Every security-relevant observation goes through this shape.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this security event (e.g. 'sec-2026-04-26-0001').

category.description: Threat classification. Must match Security Agent prompt taxonomy.

severity.description: Impact severity. CRITICAL reserved for incidents requiring immediate playbook execution.

summary.description: Human-readable one-sentence description of the event.

detected_at.description: UTC timestamp when the event was detected.

detected_by.description: Detector identity. Usually agent_security, but other agents and external systems may also emit events.

indicators_matched.description: List of indicators (rule names, IoC types) that triggered classification.

ioc.description: Indicators of compromise. Free-form key/value pairs.

affected_principals.description: Agents, users, or accounts affected by or involved in this event.

playbook_ref.description: Path to the incident response playbook that applies (e.g. '/bootstrap/incident_response_playbooks/phishing_playbook.txt').

recommended_actions.description: Suggested immediate actions for downstream agents.

context_message_id.description: If this event was triggered by a specific message, its message_id.

remediation_status.description: Lifecycle stage for the event. Defaults to 'new' on emission.

examples.summary: Quarantined phishing email targeting users with credential harvest form.
